name: CQ-the-ask-ignored
old: const turn = () => keyed.find(([k]) => started.get(k)?.wanted) ?? keyed.find(([k]) => started.get(k)?.prog === null);

name: CQ-started-out-of-turn
old: else if (!s.prog) s.wanted = true; // COMPILE-QUEUE: a queued pair waits its turn, at the front
new: else if (!s.prog) started.set(k, (s = link(gl, vs, fs))); // COMPILE-QUEUE: a queued pair waits its turn, at the front

name: CQ-a-null-program-read
CQ-the-queued-pair-taken-as-a-program
old: const { prog, vs, fs } = took?.prog ? took : link(gl, vsSrc, fsSrc); // COMPILE-QUEUE: a queued pair is compiled here, out of its turn
new: const { prog, vs, fs } = took ?? link(gl, vsSrc, fsSrc); // COMPILE-QUEUE: a queued pair is compiled here, out of its turn

name: CQ-a-taken-pair-started-again
old: const turn = () => keyed.find(([k]) => started.get(k)?.wanted) ?? keyed.find(([k]) => started.get(k)?.prog === null);

name: CQ-a-queued-pair-freed-as-a-program
old:
if (!s.prog) continue; // COMPILE-QUEUE: queued and never started - its turn is dropped, nothing to free
    gl.deleteShader(s.vs);

name: CQ-the-turn-waits-on-a-taken-program
new: while (!gl.isContextLost?.() && gl.getProgramParameter(s.prog, ext.COMPLETION_STATUS_KHR) !== true) await wait();

name: CQ-the-turn-blind-to-the-loss
new: while (started.get(k) === s && gl.getProgramParameter(s.prog, ext.COMPLETION_STATUS_KHR) !== true) await wait();

name: CQ-the-queued-pairs-left-behind
old: for (const [k] of keyed) if (started.get(k)?.prog === null) started.delete(k); // a queue that ends early strands no pair: its door starts it
new: // a queue that ends early strands no pair: its door starts it

name: CQ-the-play-programs-all-at-once
new: for (const p of playPrograms()) void startProgramsInTurn(gl, [p], wait);
